what: For the hir-ty/hir-ty-mir subagent, from round3d (my crates' tests, causes in hir-ty*): (1) hir-ty-share tests::a_vtable_and_a_method_tell_types_apart: `pub fn erase<T: Show>(x: &T) -> &dyn Show { x }` (minicore has unsize, coerce_unsized) has MIR that failed to lower; rustc accepts it (WF of &'a T gives T: 'a). (3) blaze-items tests::coherence::an_alias_with_impl_trait_takes_its_hidden_type_from_its_defining_body: tait_hidden_types of `pub type Opaque = impl Tr;` defined by `#[define_opaque(Opaque)] fn opaque() -> Opaque { 0u32 }` is [{type error}], not u32.
